info.title: ChronoDesk Human Web API
info.description: Canonical Human Web contract for browser sessions, membership-filtered project work, platform governance, and the P1 operator surfaces consumed by the Web application.

tags.name: Human sessions
tags.description: Browser authentication and immediately revocable human sessions.

tags.name: Project access
tags.description: Project access derived only from explicit active membership.

tags.name: Platform governance

tags.name: Security and emergency
tags.description: Platform-wide Agent safety controls available only to the exact emergency-operator duty.

tags.name: Cross-project workbench
tags.description: Membership-filtered ordinary human work across explicitly authorized Projects.

tags.name: Tickets
tags.description: Project-scoped Human Ticket queries and commands.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Project notifications and user-level delivery preferences.

tags.name: Automation

tags.name: Webhooks

tags.name: Agent administration

tags.name: Account security

tags.name: Project directories

tags.name: Ticket relationships

post.summary: Register a human account
post.description: Creates a member identity. When email verification is enabled, no usable browser session is issued until the one-time verification token is consumed.

post.summary: Create a human browser session
post.description: Authenticates a human and returns the platform role carried by the revocable browser session.

post.summary: Refresh a human browser session
post.description: Rotates the HttpOnly browser refresh Cookie after revalidating the persisted platform role and account state. Query parameters, JSON bodies and X-Refresh-Token are not accepted.

post.summary: Request a human password reset
post.description: Accepts an email address without revealing whether an account exists. When applicable, the server attempts to queue the durable password-reset workflow; account lookup and workflow dependency outcomes do not change the public success envelope.

post.summary: Reset a human password with a one-time token
post.description: Consumes a valid one-time password-reset token, changes the password, and revokes the affected account's active sessions.

post.summary: Verify a human email address
post.description: Consumes a one-time email-verification token from the JSON request body. Tokens are never accepted from the HTTP query string.

post.summary: Request another human email-verification message
post.description: Accepts an email address without revealing whether an unverified account exists. When applicable, the server attempts to queue a fresh one-time verification workflow; account lookup and workflow dependency outcomes do not change the public success envelope.

post.summary: End one human browser session
post.description: Idempotently revokes the session identified by the HttpOnly browser refresh Cookie only when X-Chronodesk-Session-ID matches that Cookie's signed session, then clears the Cookie on success. Query parameters, JSON bodies and X-Refresh-Token are not accepted. The explicit trusted-device credential remains until it expires, is individually revoked, or the human ends all sessions.

parameters.name: X-Chronodesk-Session-ID
parameters.description: Stable sid from the calling tab's in-memory human access token. Prevents a stale tab from clearing a newer shared refresh Cookie.

200.description: Browser session ended or already absent

post.summary: End all sessions for the current human
post.description: Revokes every persisted session and every persisted trusted-device credential for the authenticated human, then clears this browser's refresh and trusted-device Cookies after the transaction succeeds. When a refresh Cookie is present, its signed session must match the authenticated access-token session so a stale tab cannot clear a newer login.

get.summary: Get the current human session user
get.description: Returns the persisted account and optional profile projected into the current browser session.

put.description: Updates the optional profile fields owned by the authenticated human identity.

post.summary: Regenerate the current human's OTP backup codes
post.description: Requires a current-password step-up and active OTP. The authenticated user's previous password hash, OTP state, and backup-code hashes are compared atomically; a concurrent authentication change returns `backup_codes_changed` without codes. A winning change and the secret-free `backup_codes_regenerated` authentication security audit commit in one transaction. This route has a dedicated authenticated-user-and-route Redis limit of at most 5 requests per 15 minutes in addition to the shared authenticated limiter.

200.description: Exactly ten new single-use plaintext backup codes. Only this winning response receives the codes.

400.description: Strict JSON is missing current_password, is empty, malformed, or contains unknown fields (`invalid_request`)

401.description: The bearer is invalid or current_password is wrong (`invalid_password`)

409.description: OTP is disabled (`otp_not_enabled`) or the password, OTP state, or backup codes changed concurrently (`backup_codes_changed`)

503.description: Atomic rotation, audit persistence, PostgreSQL, or Redis is unavailable and the operation fails closed

get.summary: List the current human's trusted devices
get.description: Returns one owner-scoped page. The default order places active devices first and then orders by expiry and unique ID descending. When another sort is requested, the selected field and unique ID use the requested direction.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort field. Non-default sorts append the unique ID in the same direction.

delete.summary: Revoke one trusted device owned by the current human
delete.description: Revokes a trusted device owned by the authenticated human. Device ownership is enforced, so a human cannot revoke another user's device.

get.summary: List projects authorized by active membership
get.description: Returns only projects for which the current human has an active explicit membership. An authenticated human without active memberships receives 200 with an empty data array.

200.description: Projects backed by active memberships only

get.summary: Get the current authorized project context
get.description: Returns the project and project-local role resolved from the current active membership.

get.summary: List active queues in the current project
get.description: Returns active queues only. The default order places the default queue first and then orders by name and unique ID ascending. When another sort is requested, the selected field and unique ID use the requested direction.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort field. Non-default sorts append the unique ID in the same direction.

get.summary: List explicit project memberships
get.description: Lists the current project's explicit human memberships and project-local roles. The default order is is_active DESC, role ASC, user_id ASC, id ASC. When another sort is requested, the selected field and unique ID use the requested direction.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort field. Non-default sorts append the unique ID in the same direction.

post.summary: Create or update an explicit project membership
post.description: Grants one project-local role through the project administrator control plane. expected_version is mandatory: use 0 only when no membership exists, otherwise send the exact version last read from the membership directory.

get.summary: Search active users for project membership
get.description: Returns a bounded remote-search page of active human identities. Only a project administrator may use the results to mutate memberships.

delete.description: Revokes one human's project access without deleting the immutable membership history. The exact current membership version is required to prevent a stale page from revoking a newer grant.

parameters.name: expected_version
parameters.description: Exact positive membership version last read by the caller.

get.summary: List projects through platform governance
get.description: Lists every platform governance target, including active and archived projects for which the caller has no Membership. The response is a narrow governance projection and never grants or exposes a ProjectRole or trusted numeric ProjectScope.

post.summary: Create a project through platform governance
post.description: Creates a project through the independently authorized platform governance control plane.

get.summary: Get server-resolved project creation context
get.description: Resolves the authenticated single-organization context, active business units by public ID, the creator, and one bounded remote-search page of active human identities.

get.summary: List current and historical project business units
get.description: Returns a bounded remote-search dimension for platform project governance, including archived Business Units. Project creation options remain active-only.

200.description: Bounded current and historical Business Unit page

post.summary: Archive a project through platform governance
post.description: Archives one project by its canonical UUIDv7 public ID and atomically revokes its current access paths. Repeating the command for an already archived project is idempotent and returns the same platform summary.

get.summary: List platform users
get.description: Lists human identities and platform duties without synthesizing project access.

post.summary: Create a platform user
post.description: Creates one human identity with an explicit platform duty and no implicit project membership.

get.summary: Get platform user statistics
get.description: Returns account-state and platform-duty counts for governance.

get.summary: Get a platform user
get.description: Returns the platform administration view of one human identity.

put.description: Updates one human account while preserving the last active platform administrator.

delete.description: Soft-deletes one human account while preserving the last active platform administrator.

post.summary: Reset a platform user password
post.description: Replaces one human password through the audited platform administrator control plane.

get.summary: List platform audit logs
get.description: Returns immutable platform-operation audit projections to administrators and security auditors.

get.summary: Get one platform audit log detail
get.description: Returns a read-time-redacted detail projection to administrators and security auditors.

post.summary: Create a redacted platform audit CSV export
post.description: Snapshots the current explicit audit filters into an asynchronous owner-bound export job. The required UTC range cannot exceed 30 days; at most 100,000 rows are written and the completed object expires after 24 hours.

get.summary: Get the current user's platform audit export job
get.description: Returns only an export job owned by the authenticated human. Storage keys, filters, leases and fencing tokens are never exposed.

get.summary: Download a completed redacted platform audit CSV export
get.description: Streams the current owner's completed, unexpired export with no-store and checksum headers. Pending or failed jobs return 409; expired jobs return 410.

get.summary: Get platform Agent safety controls
get.description: Returns the two platform-wide Agent safety switches only to the exact emergency_operator duty. Platform administrators, security auditors, ordinary members, and project roles do not inherit this capability.

put.summary: Compare and swap platform Agent safety controls
put.description: Independently updates one or both platform-wide Agent safety switches through a strict JSON patch. If-Match must contain the current strong ETag; every attempt that reaches this emergency-operator route is written to platform audit.

412.description: If-Match identifies a stale safety-control version

get.summary: Get membership-filtered operations analytics across authorized Projects
get.description: Aggregates only active Projects for which the authenticated human has an active membership. Platform roles never expand this set. Omitting project_keys selects every authorized Project; any unknown, archived, cross-organization, or unauthorized key fails closed.

get.summary: List membership-filtered tickets across authorized Projects
get.description: Returns only Tickets visible through the authenticated human's explicit Project memberships; platform roles do not imply unrestricted Project scope.

get.summary: List visible Tickets in one authorized Project
get.description: Applies Project authorization, Ticket visibility rules, filters, and pagination before returning the current human's visible results.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: React Admin JSON filter projection accepted by the runtime adapter.

post.summary: Create a Ticket under the authorized Project configuration
post.description: Creates a Ticket through the shared domain service after validating Project access and the active Project configuration.

get.summary: List visible overdue Tickets in one authorized Project
get.description: Returns one bounded page of overdue Tickets after Project and Ticket visibility filtering.

get.summary: List visible SLA-breached Tickets in one authorized Project
get.description: Returns one bounded page of active SLA-breached Tickets after Project and Ticket visibility filtering.

get.summary: Get one visible Ticket
get.description: Returns one Ticket only when the authenticated human can access both its Project and the Ticket under the shared visibility policy.

put.summary: Update one Ticket with If-Match optimistic concurrency
put.description: Updates an authorized Ticket through the shared domain service and rejects stale versions through the required If-Match header.

delete.summary: Delete one Ticket with If-Match optimistic concurrency
delete.description: Deletes an authorized Ticket through the shared domain service and rejects stale versions through the required If-Match header.

post.summary: Assign one Ticket with optimistic concurrency
post.description: Assigns an authorized Ticket through the shared domain service and rejects stale versions through the required If-Match header.

post.summary: Transfer one Ticket with optimistic concurrency
post.description: Transfers an authorized Ticket to another assignee through the shared domain service and records the transfer reason.

post.summary: Escalate one Ticket with optimistic concurrency
post.description: Escalates an authorized Ticket through the shared domain service and records the required escalation reason.

post.summary: Transition one Ticket status with optimistic concurrency
post.description: Transitions an authorized Ticket through its published workflow and returns a conflict when the transition or resource version is stale.

409.description: The Ticket version is stale or the requested canonical status is not valid in the bound workflow.

get.summary: Get allowed transitions for one Ticket
get.description: Projects the exact immutable workflow version bound to the authorized Ticket into the lifecycle statuses the current human actor may select.

get.summary: List the visible history of one Ticket
get.description: Returns the authorized Ticket's history projection with customer visibility filtering applied before serialization.

get.summary: List the visible comments of one Ticket
get.description: Returns comments visible to the authenticated human; requester responses exclude internal comments and privileged actor metadata.

post.summary: Create one Ticket comment with optimistic concurrency
post.description: Creates a public or internal comment through the shared native service, enforcing Ticket visibility, comment visibility, and If-Match at the human boundary.

get.summary: List the visible replies of one top-level Ticket comment
get.description: Returns one bounded page of replies after applying the same Project, Ticket object, and comment visibility checks as the top-level conversation.

get.summary: List the visible attachments of one Ticket
get.description: Returns attachment metadata visible to the authenticated human; requester responses omit internal storage and actor metadata.

post.summary: Upload one Ticket attachment with optimistic concurrency
post.description: Stages an authorized multipart attachment through the shared native service and returns HTTP 202 while security scanning remains pending.

get.summary: Download one clean visible Ticket attachment
get.description: Streams attachment bytes only after Project, Ticket, visibility, and clean security-scan checks pass.

200.description: Attachment bytes served with the persisted server-detected MIME type and a safe attachment disposition.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents private attachment bytes from being stored by browsers or shared caches.

Pragma.description: Secondary cache-prevention directive for legacy HTTP clients.

X-Content-Type-Options.description: Requires clients to honor the persisted server-detected MIME type without sniffing.

Content-Security-Policy.description: Applies a restrictive sandbox if attachment bytes are interpreted as active content.

Content-Disposition.description: Always attachment. The persisted safe original filename is encoded with RFC-compatible filename or filename* parameters.

get.summary: List notifications addressed to the current human
get.description: Returns paginated Project notifications addressed to the authenticated human and never exposes another user's notification inbox.

post.summary: Create a notification in one Project
post.description: Creates a notification in an authorized Project after validating the recipient and notification payload at the HTTP boundary.

delete.description: Deletes the addressed Project notification only when the authenticated human is authorized to manage that notification.

put.summary: Mark one owned notification as read
put.description: Marks one notification as read only when it belongs to the authenticated human in the authorized Project.

put.summary: Mark all current-human notifications in one Project as read
put.description: Marks all notifications addressed to the authenticated human in the authorized Project as read.

get.summary: Count unread notifications in one Project
get.description: Counts unread notifications addressed to the authenticated human in the authorized Project.

get.summary: Get current-human notification preferences
get.description: Returns notification delivery preferences for the authenticated human without exposing another user's settings.

put.description: Replaces notification delivery preferences for the authenticated human after validating the complete preference document.

get.summary: List Project automation rules
get.description: Returns automation rules for an authorized Project through the same domain interface used by other adapters.

post.summary: Create a Project automation rule
post.description: Creates a validated automation rule in an authorized Project through the shared automation service.

get.summary: Get one Project automation rule
get.description: Returns one automation rule only within its authorized Project scope.

put.description: Updates a validated automation rule within its authorized Project through the shared automation service.

delete.description: Deletes one automation rule only within its authorized Project scope.

get.summary: List Project automation execution logs
get.description: Returns bounded automation execution summaries for an authorized Project without embedding internal Ticket or rule state.

get.summary: Get platform email configuration without secrets
get.description: Returns the platform SMTP configuration to an authorized platform administrator with credential secrets redacted.

put.description: Updates validated platform SMTP settings for an authorized platform administrator without returning stored credential secrets.

post.summary: Send a platform SMTP test email
post.description: Validates the supplied test request and sends a test message using the stored platform SMTP configuration.

get.summary: List platform data-cleanup execution logs
get.description: Returns a bounded platform-administrator page. Error text in each row is truncated by the runtime projection. Every supported sort appends the unique ID in the same requested direction.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort field. The unique ID is appended in the same direction.

get.summary: List platform system configuration
get.description: Returns platform-level system configuration visible to an authorized platform administrator.

put.summary: Update one platform system configuration value
put.description: Validates and updates one named platform configuration value for an authorized platform administrator.

get.summary: List Webhook configurations in one Project
get.description: Returns Webhook configurations to Project administrators or managers with secret values and persistence relations omitted from the response.

post.summary: Create a Webhook configuration in one Project
post.description: Creates a validated Webhook configuration in an authorized Project with server-controlled inactive status. An administrator or manager may enqueue an explicit test while inactive, but ordinary event delivery begins only after an explicit update to active.

get.summary: Get one Webhook configuration
get.description: Returns one Webhook configuration to Project administrators or managers and omits stored secret values and persistence relations.

put.description: Requires the current strong `If-Match` validator and atomically advances the same durable configuration generation used by emergency revoke before changing validated fields. A configuration with a committed emergency-revoked event is terminal and returns non-retryable `webhook_emergency_revoked`.

delete.description: Requires the current strong `If-Match` validator and soft-deletes one Webhook configuration. Already committed immutable delivery snapshots remain eligible through their original deadline; this operation never performs an emergency revoke.

post.summary: Atomically queue an immutable Webhook test delivery
post.description: Commits an immutable delivery snapshot and its Outbox event atomically, then returns HTTP 202 with stable receipt identifiers while delivery remains queued.

get.summary: List delivery attempts for one Webhook configuration
get.description: Returns a closed, non-sensitive delivery-attempt projection to Project administrators or managers.

get.summary: Get delivery statistics for one Webhook configuration
get.description: Returns cumulative configuration counters and daily delivery counts for the selected period to Project administrators or managers.

get.summary: Inspect bounded Agent control metrics
get.description: Returns only server-computed scalar metrics for the authorized Organization and Project. Dynamic control-plane resources are loaded through their independent page or cursor operations.

get.summary: List service principals and their Project grant
get.description: Returns a stable page of service principals and project grants for the selected project. Only project administrators may access this project-scoped directory; page size is capped at 100.

200.description: Stable page ordered by created_at DESC, id DESC.

post.summary: Create a service principal and initial credential
post.description:
The returned client secret is shown once and is never stored in
plaintext. `If-Match` is not used because this creates a new top-level
resource. Repeating the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the
encrypted replay of the original one-time response. The Project is
bound by the authorized path; the principal and its initial Project
grant are committed atomically, with no implicit default authorization.

example.name: incident-triage-agent
example.description: Triages and works production incident tickets.

201.description: One-time OAuth client credential and administrator operation receipt.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents storage of the one-time client secret.

Pragma.description: Secondary cache-prevention directive for the one-time client secret.

put.summary: Update status and safety controls for a service principal
put.description:
Use the matching principal's `resource_version` from the administrator
overview as `If-Match`. An exact idempotent replay returns the original
body, status, and ETag.

post.summary: Rotate a service principal credential
post.description:
Existing active credentials are revoked after the new one is issued.
Use the principal's `resource_version` from the administrator overview
as `If-Match`. Exact idempotent retries return the same one-time secret,
body, status, cache headers, and ETag.

200.description: New one-time OAuth client credential and administrator operation receipt.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents storage of the one-time client secret.

Pragma.description: Secondary cache-prevention directive for the one-time client secret.

delete.description:
Use the parent principal's `resource_version` from the administrator
overview as `If-Match`. Exact idempotent retries return the original
receipt and ETag.

get.summary: List explicit allow and deny policies
get.description: Returns closed policy summaries without policy condition payloads. Every row includes the resource_version required for policy commands.

post.summary: Add an explicit allow or deny policy
post.description:
Use the parent principal's `resource_version` from the administrator
overview as `If-Match`. The response ETag identifies the new policy at
version 1; `X-Parent-ETag` identifies the advanced principal version.
Exact idempotent retries preserve both validators.

delete.summary: Disable an Agent policy without deleting its audit history
delete.description:
Use the matching policy's `resource_version` from the policy list as
`If-Match`. Exact idempotent retries return the original receipt and
policy ETag.

get.summary: List active Agent ticket leases
get.description: Returns a stable page of active Agent ticket leases in the selected project. Only project administrators may access the list; page size is capped at 100.

200.description: Stable page ordered by expires_at ASC, id ASC.

post.summary: Force release an Agent lease for administrator takeover
post.description:
Use the lease's `resource_version` from the administrator overview as
`If-Match`. Exact idempotent retries return the original released lease
snapshot, receipt, and ETag.

get.summary: List safe attachment scan summaries
get.description: Storage paths, URLs, access tokens, hashes, metadata, and long scan details are omitted.

200.description: Stable page ordered by created_at DESC, id DESC.

post.summary: Record a terminal attachment malware-scan result
post.description:
Use the attachment's `resource_version` from the administrator overview
as `If-Match`. Exact idempotent retries return the original scan result,
receipt, and ETag.

get.summary: List safe Outbox delivery summaries
get.description: Destination identifiers are replaced by controlled type labels and failure text is scrubbed and bounded.

200.description: Stable page ordered by immutable created_at DESC, id DESC.

post.summary: Requeue an Outbox delivery
post.description:
Use the delivery's `resource_version` from the administrator overview
as `If-Match`. Exact idempotent retries return the original accepted
response, receipt, and ETag without requeueing twice.

get.summary: List soft-deleted Webhooks eligible for independent emergency revoke
get.description: Returns a bounded, secret-free Project page so an exact `project_admin` can rediscover soft-deleted Webhooks after refresh. Ordinary delete does not invoke emergency revoke. A terminal item with `emergency_revoked=true` exposes no further revoke action.

Cache-Control.description: Tombstone security state must not be cached.

get.summary: Read the current secret-free emergency-revoke preflight
get.description: Revalidates the exact `project_admin` membership in the Project transaction and returns the current durable Webhook configuration generation for active or soft-deleted configurations. The response contains no name, URL, credential, snapshot, or delivery identifier.

Cache-Control.description: Emergency preflight state must not be cached.

post.summary: Emergency-revoke pending deliveries for one Project Webhook
post.description: Use the preflight `resource_version` as `If-Match` and supply an `Idempotency-Key`. The command is restricted to the exact `project_admin` role. In one Project transaction it disables and crypto-shreds the mutable configuration, expires pending, failed, dead, and new prepared-but-not-started deliveries, and shreds every unterminated immutable snapshot credential with reason `revoked`. `in_flight_deliveries` counts real dispatch-start authorizations plus legacy/unknown processing claims that cannot be safely recalled. The response, receipt, audit event, and Domain Event contain no destination URL or credential material. Ordinary edit, disable, and delete continue to preserve committed immutable deliveries through their original deadline.

200.description: Webhook emergency revoke committed with a stable receipt.

get.summary: Continue through safe Domain Event summaries
get.description: Event Data is omitted. The opaque cursor is HMAC-bound to the authorized Organization and Project, limit, filters, and sort version.

200.description: Stable continuation ordered by created_at DESC, id DESC.

get.summary: Continue through safe policy decision summaries
get.description: Decision Context and request digests are omitted. The opaque cursor is HMAC-bound to the authorized Organization and Project, limit, filters, and sort version.

200.description: Stable continuation ordered by created_at DESC, id DESC.

get.summary: List the current human login history
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of login records owned by the authenticated human. Records from other users are never exposed, and page size is capped at 100.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Exact server-side session identifier filter. Never returned in the response.

delete.summary: Revoke and remove one current-human login session
delete.description: Revokes and removes a login-history session owned by the authenticated human. Session ownership is enforced before deletion.

get.summary: List visible categories in the current project
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of categories visible to the authenticated project member. Results are restricted to the selected project and page size is capped at 100.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON-encoded closed filter with ids, status, parent_id, q, or search.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Legacy React Admin two-element JSON sort tuple.

get.summary: Get one visible category in the current project
get.description: Returns one category only when it belongs to the selected project and is visible to the authenticated project member.

get.summary: Search assignable project members
get.description: Returns a stable, remotely searchable page of members eligible for assignment in the selected project. Project membership is required and page size is capped at 100.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON-encoded closed filter with ids, q, or search.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Legacy React Admin two-element JSON sort tuple.

get.summary: Get one assignable project member
get.description: Returns one assignable member only when the user belongs to the selected project and is eligible for assignment there.

get.summary: List entity links for one Ticket
get.description: Returns a stable page of immutable entity links for a visible Ticket in the selected project. Project access and Ticket visibility are enforced; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Add an immutable entity link to one Ticket
post.description: Adds an immutable external-entity link to a visible Ticket in the selected project. Observer access is read-only; the caller must hold a project role permitted to update Tickets.

get.summary: List Ticket relations for one Ticket
get.description: Returns a stable page of immutable Ticket relations for a visible Ticket in the selected project. Project access and Ticket visibility are enforced; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Add an immutable relation between two project Tickets
post.description: Creates an immutable relation between two visible Tickets in the same project. Observer access is read-only, and cross-project relations are rejected.

get.summary: List project runs
get.description: Returns a stable page of Agent collaboration runs in the selected project. Any authenticated project member may read the project-scoped list; page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: Get one project runs record
get.description: Returns one Agent collaboration run only when it belongs to the selected project and the caller is a project member.

get.summary: List project proposals
get.description: Returns a stable page of Agent action proposals in the selected project. Any authenticated project member may read the project-scoped list; page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: Get one project proposals record
get.description: Returns one Agent action proposal only when it belongs to the selected project and the caller is a project member.

get.summary: List project approvals
get.description: Returns a stable page of Agent approval tasks in the selected project. Any authenticated project member may read the project-scoped list; page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: Get one project approvals record
get.description: Returns one Agent approval task only when it belongs to the selected project and the caller is a project member.

get.summary: List project handoffs
get.description: Returns a stable page of human-Agent handoffs in the selected project. Any authenticated project member may read the project-scoped list; page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: Get one project handoffs record
get.description: Returns one bounded human-Agent handoff record only when it belongs to the selected project and the caller is a project member.

post.summary: Approve or reject one project Agent action
post.description: Records an approval or rejection for one pending Agent action in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may decide approvals.

post.summary: Take over one project Agent run
post.description: Transfers one Agent run in the selected project to human control and returns a bounded result. Project administrators, managers, and agents may perform the takeover.

get.summary: Get the bounded published intake configuration for one project
get.description: Returns the selected project's published intake configuration as bounded request-type and workflow collections. Any authenticated project member may read it; each collection is capped at 100 items.

get.summary: List project SLA configurations
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of SLA configurations in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may access the directory; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Create a project SLA configuration
post.description: Creates an SLA configuration in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may change project automation configuration.

get.summary: List project Ticket templates
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of Ticket templates in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may access the directory; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Create a project Ticket template
post.description: Creates a Ticket template in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may change project automation configuration.

get.summary: Get one project Ticket template
get.description: Returns one Ticket template only when it belongs to the selected project. Access is limited to project administrators and managers.

get.summary: List visible project quick replies
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of quick replies visible in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may access the directory; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Create a project quick reply
post.description: Creates a quick reply in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may change project automation configuration.

post.summary: Record use of one visible project quick reply
post.description: Records use of a visible quick reply in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and agents may record usage; cross-project access is rejected.

get.summary: List project knowledge articles
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of knowledge articles in the selected project. The default view contains only published articles allowed by the live knowledge ACL. Project administrators and managers may request view=manage; members with the explicit knowledge contributor capability may request view=mine for articles they personally manage. Page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Create a project knowledge article
post.description: Creates an authored Markdown article and its first draft version, with optional immutable ticket and clean-attachment provenance. Project administrators and managers may create drafts; an ordinary active member may do so only when the membership has the explicit knowledge contributor capability. Contributors cannot grant project-wide access or publish. This operation never publishes the draft.

post.summary: Create a new authored knowledge draft
post.description: Creates a new immutable Markdown draft version for an existing article, with optional ticket and clean-attachment provenance. Project administrators and managers may create drafts; an explicitly authorized knowledge contributor may revise only an article for which that human already has the manage ACL. This operation never publishes drafts.

get.summary: Get one authored knowledge document
get.description: Returns the selected version or current published version as bounded Markdown sections with immutable ticket and attachment provenance. Managers may inspect drafts; an article manager may inspect that article's draft; other project roles require a published version and a matching live read ACL.

parameters.name: prefer_latest_draft
parameters.description: When true, resolve the latest draft version instead of the current published version. The live manage ACL is still required; version_id and this flag are mutually exclusive.

get.summary: List versions of one project knowledge article
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of versions for one knowledge article in the selected project. Access is limited to project administrators and managers, and page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Publish one authored knowledge version
post.description: Publishes a clean, fully ingested draft, grants project-wide read access, and atomically advances the article's current version. Only project administrators and managers may publish; published versions remain immutable.

post.summary: Search published project knowledge
post.description: Runs a bounded hybrid search over published knowledge and returns persisted, verifiable citations. Results are filtered by the caller's live project membership and knowledge ACL.

get.summary: List project knowledge ingestion tasks
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of knowledge ingestion tasks in the selected project. Access is limited to project administrators and managers, and page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: Get the current project knowledge index state
get.description: Returns the current bounded knowledge-index state for the selected project. Any authenticated member of that project may read the state.

post.summary: Queue a durable project knowledge index rebuild
post.description: Queues a durable knowledge-index rebuild for the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may start a rebuild.

get.summary: List Tickets created by or assigned to the current human
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of Tickets in the selected project that were created by or assigned to the authenticated human. Project membership is required and page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: List unassigned Tickets in the current project
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of unassigned Tickets in the selected project. Access is limited to project administrators, managers, and agents, and page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: List connector definitions in the current project
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of connector definitions in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Create a connector definition in the current project
post.description: Creates a connector definition in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may change integration configuration.

put.description: Updates a mutable connector definition in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may change integration configuration.

get.summary: List safe connection summaries in the current project
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of redacted connection summaries in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; credentials are never returned and page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Create a project connection without returning credentials
post.description: Creates a connection in the selected project without echoing stored credentials. Only project administrators and managers may change integration configuration.

put.summary: Update a project connection without returning credentials
put.description: Updates a connection in the selected project without returning stored credentials. Only project administrators and managers may change integration configuration.

get.summary: List mapping versions for one project connection
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of mapping versions for one connection in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Create a mapping draft for one project connection
post.description: Creates a mapping draft for one connection in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may change integration mappings.

put.summary: Update a mapping draft using optimistic concurrency
put.description: Updates a mapping draft in the selected project using optimistic concurrency. Only project administrators and managers may change integration mappings.

post.summary: Preview a mapping without writing Inbox state
post.description: Returns a bounded dry-run preview for one mapping in the selected project without persisting Inbox processing state. Only project administrators and managers may run the preview.

post.summary: Publish an immutable mapping version
post.description: Publishes an immutable mapping version in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may publish integration mappings.

get.summary: Get a bounded integration health overview
get.description: Returns a bounded, redacted integration health overview for the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read the overview.

get.summary: List safe Inbox message metadata
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of redacted Inbox message metadata in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; payload content is not exposed and page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: List processing receipts for one Inbox message
get.description: Returns a stable, filterable page of processing receipts for one Inbox message in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: List bounded synchronization runs
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of synchronization runs in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; page size is capped at 100.

get.summary: List integration conflicts
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of integration conflicts in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Resolve or ignore an open integration conflict
post.description: Resolves or ignores one open integration conflict in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may record a resolution.

get.summary: List integration dead letters
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of redacted integration dead letters in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; page size is capped at 100.

post.summary: Replay one open integration dead letter
post.description: Queues a replay for one open integration dead letter in the selected project. Only project administrators and managers may initiate the replay.

get.summary: List domain events with a scope-bound cursor
get.description: Returns a stable cursor page of domain events in the selected project. The cursor is bound to project scope, filters, and sort order; project administrators, managers, and observers may read up to 100 items per request.

get.summary: List redacted Outbox delivery state
get.description: Returns a stable, searchable page of redacted Outbox delivery state in the selected project. Project administrators, managers, and observers may read it; delivery secrets are never exposed and page size is capped at 100.

humanRefreshCookie.name: chronodesk_refresh_token
humanRefreshCookie.description: Rotating HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict browser credential scoped to /api/auth. Production deployments also require Secure.

TicketUnprocessableEntity.description: The Ticket write is structurally valid but violates a published workflow, trusted-source, form, tag, Agent-context, or category rule.

TicketPayloadTooLarge.description: The Human Ticket JSON request body exceeds the 1 MiB limit.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The authentication JSON request body exceeds the 64 KiB limit

Forbidden.description: Authenticated identity lacks the required explicit capability, or the requested project scope is unavailable. `project_access_revoked` is reserved for project-scope resolution or revalidation; role and object authorization denials do not invalidate the active project.

Conflict.description: Requested change conflicts with persisted resource state

Gone.description: Requested export object has expired and is no longer available

RequestTimeout.description: The authentication request exceeded its bounded deadline

TooManyRequests.description: The human identity or client exceeded the configured rate limit

InternalServerError.description: The requested operation failed inside the service

ServiceUnavailable.description: A fail-closed authentication or application dependency is unavailable

PreconditionRequired.description: A required optimistic concurrency precondition was omitted.

StandardError.description: The Human Web handler returned a closed code, message, and optional data error envelope.

AgentAdminUnauthorized.description:
Bearer token is missing, invalid, expired, or has the wrong audience.
On service-principal endpoints, the challenge contains the exact
audience-specific `resource_metadata` URL for `/api/v2` or `/a2a/v1`;
human-admin endpoints use the human session challenge.

AgentAdminForbidden.description:
The credential lacks the required scope or policy denied the action.
The problem code is `insufficient_scope` or `policy_denied`.

example.title: policy denied
example.detail: Risky action requires an explicit allow policy.

AgentAdminInternalError.description: The command failed before a durable, replayable result could be committed.

example.title: internal error
example.detail: Failed to persist administrator domain event.

AgentAdminBadRequest.description: Request shape, header, cursor, or command category is invalid.

AgentAdminConflict.description:
Optimistic version, lease ownership, or idempotency conflict. Inspect
`code` for `version_conflict`, `lease_conflict`, or
`idempotency_conflict`.

value.title: version conflict
value.detail: Expected ticket version does not match current version.

value.title: lease conflict
value.detail: Ticket lease is expired or held by another principal.

AgentAdminPayloadTooLarge.description: Attachment or request body exceeds the configured limit.

AgentAdminServiceUnavailable.description: A required shared execution-protection or persistence dependency is temporarily unavailable.

Retry-After.description: Minimum number of seconds before a retry.

example.title: service unavailable
example.detail: Agent execution protection is temporarily unavailable.

AgentAdminNotFound.description: Resource is missing or is not visible to the caller.

AgentAdminAdminConflict.description:
Administrator resource version, command state, or idempotency conflict.
For `version_conflict`, ETag contains the current strong resource
validator and the caller must reload the corresponding overview or
policy-list resource before retrying.

value.title: version conflict
value.detail: Administrator resource version does not match.

value.title: webhook emergency revoked
value.detail: The emergency-revoked Webhook configuration is terminal.

value.title: idempotency conflict
value.detail: Idempotency key was reused with different command input.

AgentAdminPreconditionRequired.description: A mutating request omitted the mandatory current-resource `If-Match` validator.

example.title: precondition required
example.detail: If-Match is required for this administrator command.

ProjectPublicID.name: projectPublicID
ProjectPublicID.description: Canonical lowercase RFC UUIDv7 public identifier for a project.

AuditPathPrefix.name: path_prefix
AuditPathPrefix.description: Preferred resource path prefix filter. It cannot be combined with the legacy path parameter.

AuditTimePreset.name: time_preset
AuditTimePreset.description: Relative UTC range ending at request time; cannot be combined with start_time or end_time.

AuditCursor.name: cursor
AuditCursor.description: Opaque stable pagination cursor bound to the current filters, limit and ordering.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Caller-generated key, scoped to actor and operation. Reuse with the
same request digest returns the first result; reuse with a different
digest returns `409 idempotency_conflict`.

AgentListCursor.name: cursor
AgentListCursor.description: Opaque HMAC-protected continuation bound to the Organization, Project, filters, limit, and sort version.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag of the current resource version used for optimistic concurrency.

avatar.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Omit it when editing other fields. Runtime accepts empty to clear or the exact current value as a no-op; only the controlled avatar upload endpoint may persist a new value.

knowledge_contributor.description: Optional explicit grant allowing an active ordinary project member to create article drafts and revise only articles they manage. It never grants publication, ACL, model-policy, index-management, or other authors' revision rights.

expected_version.description: Optimistic concurrency precondition. Use 0 only to create a membership that does not exist; an existing membership requires its exact positive current version.

phone.description: Omitted or null leaves the phone unchanged; an E.164 string replaces it; a string that is empty after trimming clears it.

avatar.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Omit it when editing other fields. Runtime accepts empty to clear or the exact current value as a no-op; only a dedicated avatar upload endpoint may persist a new value.

can_create_knowledge_drafts.description: Effective Human permission for creating new knowledge article drafts in this project. Project administrators and managers are always true.

knowledge_contributor.description: Explicit draft-only knowledge grant stored on this membership. Project administrator and manager publishing rights are role-derived instead.

code.description: `project_access_revoked` means the requested project scope is unavailable to the authenticated human. A browser may clear its active selection only when that response names the same project; role and object authorization denials use other codes.

HumanTicketSource.description: Human-authored ticket sources. The trusted agent source is assigned only by the machine intake boundary.

channel.description: Manual notification creation supports only application and durable email delivery.

webhook_enabled.description: Reserved compatibility field. Notification Webhook delivery is not available in this release and the value is always false.

do_not_disturb_start.description: Optional absolute start of the application-notification quiet interval.

do_not_disturb_end.description: Optional absolute end of the application-notification quiet interval; both bounds must be supplied and end must be later than start.

max_daily_count.description: Per-Project UTC-day limit for visible application notifications of this type. The same value applies independently in every Project; zero means unlimited.

batch_delivery.description: Reserved compatibility field. Batch notification delivery is not available in this release and the value is always false.

batch_interval.description: Reserved compatibility value for the unavailable batch-delivery feature.

webhook_enabled.description: Reserved compatibility field; must be false because notification Webhook delivery is unavailable.

do_not_disturb_start.description: Optional absolute start of the application-notification quiet interval.

do_not_disturb_end.description: Optional absolute end of the application-notification quiet interval; both bounds must be supplied and end must be later than start.

max_daily_count.description: Per-Project UTC-day limit for visible application notifications of this type. The same value applies independently in every Project; zero means unlimited.

batch_delivery.description: Reserved compatibility field; must be false because batch notification delivery is unavailable.

batch_interval.description: Reserved compatibility value for the unavailable batch-delivery feature.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor; clients must not inspect or modify it.

has_more.description: Whether the underlying candidate stream may contain another page.

AgentPolicyScope.description: A least-privilege Agent scope or `*` for an explicit cross-scope policy.

AgentPolicyConditions.description: Structured policy predicates interpreted only by the policy engine.

ui_schema.description: Validated project intake UI schema object.

has_unpublished_draft.description: Present only in authorized mine/manage directory views.

latest_draft_at.description: Latest unpublished draft activity; present only when an authorized management view has a draft.

latest_draft_version.description: Latest unpublished immutable draft version; present only in authorized mine/manage directory views.

CreateKnowledgeDraftRequest.x-chronodesk-source-constraint: source_attachment_ids requires source_ticket_id and must contain unique clean attachments from that ticket

visibility.description: Live source projection. Protected Ticket and Attachment fields are present only for full.

source_ticket_id.description: Present only after live source Ticket authorization.

source_attachment_id.description: Present only after live source Attachment authorization.

ticket_number.description: Authorized untrusted snapshot of the source ticket number.

ticket_title.description: Authorized untrusted snapshot of the source ticket title.

attachment_name.description: Authorized untrusted snapshot of the source attachment name.

attachment_hash.description: Authorized SHA-256 snapshot of the source attachment.
